summary: Backend regression testing (pytest) for Bimbel AELC — 20/20 passed. Covered: JWT login + bad password, /auth/me with Bearer, unauth 401, /auth/session missing/invalid X-Session-ID (400/401), Students CRUD (auto no_urut increment, sorted list, update persistence), Teachers CRUD, Allocations with NEW invoice format `{FirstName}-INV-AELC-{MM}-{no_urut}` verified end-to-end, Paid/Unpaid toggle, Schedules Monday accepted + Sunday rejected (422), Dashboard stats (5 fields), NEW revenue-monthly endpoint (6 buckets ascending, last=current YYYY-MM), Settings GET defaults + PUT company persistence, Logo upload/delete + oversize 400 rejection, Student cascade delete (allocations + schedules).

minor.issue: DAY Literal still includes 'Saturday' although PRD/frontend is Mon-Fri only. Sunday is rejected (422) but Saturday would silently be accepted.
Response no longer includes a legacy 'total_alokasi' or similar count; not required by frontend but worth confirming with UI.

next_invoice_no() fallback branch (when student_id is empty/not found) still uses old regex `INV-AELC-{year}-` while active format uses `{MM}` — mismatched sequence counting. Not hit in normal flow but dead-inconsistent code path.

action_items: (Optional) Remove 'Saturday' from DAY Literal in server.py to match Mon-Fri PRD.
(Optional) Update next_invoice_no fallback regex to match new `{MM}` format for sequence counting.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py DAY Literal includes Saturday but frontend only supports Mon-Fri — inconsistent validation surface.
next_invoice_no fallback branch mixes old (YYYY) and new (MM) formats — dead-inconsistent, could cause duplicate invoice numbers if ever triggered.

get_current_user JWT branch queries `{'id': payload['sub']}` while session branch uses `user_id` — both fields set for admin so OK, but Google-only users could break bearer-JWT lookup (not applicable now).
server.py is ~554 lines and single-file; consider splitting into routers/models modules if it grows further (still acceptable at current size).
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_-prefixed students/teachers/allocations/schedules and clean up via session-scoped fixture teardown.
